# Next Mission

> Veterans already know PPE, decon, incident command and following procedures under pressure. HAZWOPER training to turn military experience into an environmental or emergency response career.

Next Mission (https://veterans.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 40-Hour HAZWOPER, Incident Command (q), Train-the-Trainer, HAZWOPER Supervisor training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://veterans.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://veterans.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). The credential most employers ask for. Enroll: https://veterans.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=587
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER (q) Incident Command Training](https://veterans.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-q-incident-command-training): $199.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q). Put your command experience on paper. Enroll: https://veterans.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-q-incident-command-training?buy=593
- [HAZWOPER Train-the-Trainer Certification](https://veterans.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-train-the-trainer-certification): $399.99 per seat, 24 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e). For veterans who trained troops. Enroll: https://veterans.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-train-the-trainer-certification?buy=1016
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Supervisor Training](https://veterans.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-training): $69.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(4). For NCOs and officers. Enroll: https://veterans.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-training?buy=597
